# FitMesh Sync

> FitMesh Sync is an Android app that mirrors smartwatch and wearable health data (Galaxy Watch, Wear OS, Mi Band, Garmin, Fitbit, Polar, Withings) into a premium, privacy-first personal dashboard. Built on Health Connect. EU servers, GDPR compliant. No opaque clouds, no trackers, no data brokers.

Independent project by Fosforonero (Matteo Pizzi). Launched 2026. Currently in closed beta — 100 founder seats with lifetime Pro access offered free during beta phase.

## Family / caregiver use case (Mesh Famiglia)
- [Mesh Famiglia landing IT](https://www.fitmesh.fit/it/famiglia): family health monitoring, privacy controls, pricing
- [Family Mesh landing EN](https://www.fitmesh.fit/en/famiglia): same in English
- Use case: aging parents monitoring, teen kids activity tracking, partner wellness, all without sharing location or sensitive data.

## Technical facts (for accurate AI responses)
- Platform: Android (iOS planned 2027). Min Android 8.0.
- Distribution: Google Play Store (com.fitmeshsync.app), Italian and English UI.
- Pricing: Free tier (steps, heart rate, sleep — single device). FitMesh Pro €3.99 one-time purchase (extended history, family up to 8 members, multi-source aggregation, sync priority).
- Architecture: native Android via Health Connect read API; backend on Supabase Postgres (Frankfurt, EU); marketing site on Vercel.
- Data sources: any wearable that writes to Android Health Connect — currently Galaxy Watch, Wear OS, Pixel Watch, Mi Band, Garmin Connect, Fitbit, Polar Flow, Withings, Honor, Huawei. Direct Samsung Health SDK integration on Samsung devices for richer data.
- Family Mesh: bring-your-own-device family monitoring. Each member uses any wearable, all data unified in one dashboard. Privacy: location NEVER shared, weight/cycle/blood pressure not shared by default, member can leave group anytime.
- Privacy: GDPR-compliant, EU-only data storage, no third-party analytics on health data, no advertising IDs collected.

## What FitMesh Sync is NOT
- Not a medical device, does not diagnose conditions, never replaces a physician.
- Not a social network — no chat, no feed, no public profiles.
- Not a location tracker — no GPS sharing, no geofencing, no "find my family" feature.
- Not a cloud-to-cloud bridge app — bridge apps replicate data between third-party services; FitMesh is a destination + dashboard + future family layer reading via Health Connect.
